messages:
evan: FYI CS flagged a new wave of onboarding tickets: JS quickstart shows `Error: Bad request` with zero context. Go/Python show `InvalidArgument` + actionable hint. We should fix parity + ensure errors are machine- and human-friendly.
priya: Agreed. Two quick asks: (A) surface a canonical envelope on the wire; (B) ensure SDKs emit typed exceptions and also metric labels for errors.
marco: For (A) server RFC already defines `code,human_message,hint,http_status,retry_after`. Can we minify it on the wire? e.g. {"c":"InvalidArgument","h":"prompt too long","t":400} and SDKs map keys. Saves bytes for high-volume endpoints.
lucy: I like minified but we must balance readability for trailing JSON on streams. Maybe use full keys for trailers and minified for header/base responses. Also streaming: suggest `x-rw-error: 1` header + final NDJSON trailer with envelope. SDKs fallback to status->code mapping if no body.
ev an: Typo -> evan.
ev an: (oops) my bad.
priya: For telemetry: metrics team wants an `error_code` tag on request metrics (e.g., `error_code=InvalidArgument`) and a separate `retry_after_seconds` gauge when applicable. Also add a histogram for `human_message.length` to catch noisy dumps.
marco: We'll add `error.code` to structured logs as well as `error.hint` for internal ops. Important: human_message must be scrubbed (no model internals). Enforce at server side.
lucy: SDK changes: JS/TS should export classes like `InvalidArgumentError` and also keep `err.code` string for languages without class idioms. Add a compatibility shim that maps legacy `message` -> canonical envelope for one major release and logs a deprecation warning.
evan: Sampleapp: update quickstart to prefer `instanceof` checks with a fallback to `err.code`. Replace `err.type` examples. Also add a tiny client-side snippet that shows `showToast(err.human_message)` and a short fallback if missing.
priya: Tests: 1) integration test that POSTs an oversized prompt and asserts `err.code==='InvalidArgument' && err.human_message.length>0`. 2) streaming test that simulates trailer JSON. 3) telemetry test that validates `error_code` tag emitted.
marco: Deprecation: keep compat shim for 1 major release, add server-side header `x-rw-legacy-message: 1` when we synthesize legacy bodies for older clients. After deprecation window, drop shim.
lucy: Linting: add a rule in SDK repos that throws on constructing errors without `code` and `human_message`. Also add a CI smoke test in sampleapp that hits staging and asserts typed error surface for common bad requests.
evan: Owners and ETA: marco -> server trailer/header RFC + minified format proposal (PR by Tue), lucy -> js-sdk error classes + compat shim (PR by tomorrow EOD), priya -> docs/quickstart update + telemetry labels (PR by Thu). ops-bot: Created task DEVEX-4111 "error envelope + telemetry + deprecation plan" assigned to marco,lucy,priya. https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/4111
marco: One security note: confirm that `hint` doesn't expose PII or model debug. We'll gate hints behind sanitization rules.
lucy: Will add unit tests to assert `human_message` length <= 140 and no stack traces. CI will fail if server returns suspicious content in staging tests.
evan: Excellent. CS will re-open a sample of affected tickets after deploy. Thanks team. :sparkles:
